criteria.text: A fresh machine reuses a saved completed empty review. A newer question or pending review suppresses that older completion.
Competing current reviews, edited records and revoked or unknown review authority remain unresolved; an outsider marker gives no authority.
A confirmed continuation can finish only its own pending intent. An absent confirmed edge stays absent and requires an override review.
After one edge of a two-edge intent is present, a changed requirement keeps that edge, leaves the second absent, and leaves recovery pending with no new edge write.
A lost edge-write reply is reconciled from the present native edge without adding it twice. Checked-empty save appends one durable review.
A completed current new-issue impact check reuses unaffected review heads. Unfinished or stale impact coverage does not.
A cross-repository blocker with issue number 42 and a different REST ID is added to the dependent with its REST ID. A GraphQL node ID never supplies the write identity.
